column1: # Hand-maintained dimensions for ICAO type designators that openap does not
# cover.  openap wins where both have a value; this file only fills the gaps
# and a blank cell simply renders as "-" on the display.  Corrections and new
# rows are welcome - rerun tools/make_aircraft_db.py afterwards.
# span_m     wingspan in metres.  For helicopters put the MAIN ROTOR DIAMETER
#            here; the firmware labels it ROTOR when Doc 8643 says Helicopter.
# len_m      overall length in metres (fuselage nose to tail).
# mtow_t     maximum take-off weight in tonnes.
# cruise_kt  typical cruise true airspeed in knots.
